item: Instrument honesty: injected 5 ms pre-dispatch delay and 30 ms mid-stream hold visible in the harness metrics
setup: controller, functional scale: synthprov TTFT 150 ms / ITL 20 ms / sample-mod 1; rvproto local_cpu PG2-22M, 2 workers; olg 4 req/s x 60 s (+5 s warm-up), 70% SSE, light corpus (100-170 tokens), org-a key
notes: per-stream max metrics (T_fw_addon_sse, T_release_lag_max) show the hold only by the amount it exceeds the stream's existing holdback maximum (~2 ITL for multi-token word runs): +11.4 ms at p50 in this run, +26.8 ms in the earlier run with the older synthprov build
SSE p50 in base includes 1-2 ITL of pattern-aware holdback (trailing word held until the next chunk proves it cannot become a match)
2 benign prompts blocked in base/predispatch5 by PG2-22M false positives (A.inj.sem); excluded from qualified, not an instrument issue
